package lessonexample

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

const (
	exampleTestLessonID = "30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
	exampleTestID       = "30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
)

type exampleLessonRepositoryStub struct {
	lesson domain.Lesson
}

func (r exampleLessonRepositoryStub) Create(context.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (r exampleLessonRepositoryStub) Get(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	if id != r.lesson.ID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	lesson := r.lesson
	return &lesson, nil
}
func (exampleLessonRepositoryStub) GetWithFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (exampleLessonRepositoryStub) Update(context.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (exampleLessonRepositoryStub) Delete(context.Context, string) error        { return nil }
func (exampleLessonRepositoryStub) ListByCourse(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (exampleLessonRepositoryStub) ListByCourseFields(context.Context, string, queryfields.Set, filters.LessonFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return nil, 0, nil
}
func (exampleLessonRepositoryStub) ListBySection(context.Context, string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

type exampleRepositoryStub struct {
	replaced   []domain.LessonExample
	listed     []domain.LessonExample
	activeOnly bool
	deleted    string
}

func (r *exampleRepositoryStub) ReplaceByLesson(_ context.Context, _ string, examples []domain.LessonExample) error {
	r.replaced = examples
	return nil
}
func (r *exampleRepositoryStub) Get(context.Context, string) (*domain.LessonExample, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *exampleRepositoryStub) ListByLesson(_ context.Context, _ string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExample, error) {
	r.activeOnly = activeOnly
	return r.listed, nil
}
func (r *exampleRepositoryStub) Delete(_ context.Context, id string) error {
	r.deleted = id
	return nil
}

type exampleI18nRepositoryStub struct {
	languages map[int]string
}

func (exampleI18nRepositoryStub) Create(context.Context, domain.I18n) error { return nil }
func (r exampleI18nRepositoryStub) GetByID(_ context.Context, id int) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	language, ok := r.languages[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &domain.I18n{ID: id, Language: language}, nil
}
func (r exampleI18nRepositoryStub) GetByLanguage(_ context.Context, language string) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	for id, candidate := range r.languages {
		if candidate == language {
			return &domain.I18n{ID: id, Language: language}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (exampleI18nRepositoryStub) List(context.Context) ([]domain.I18n, error) { return nil, nil }

func validLessonExample() domain.LessonExample {
	primary := "neutral"
	return domain.LessonExample{
		ID:             exampleTestID,
		SourceKey:      "foundation.lesson.neutral-example",
		Order:          1,
		Status:         domain.LessonExampleStatusActive,
		Mode:           "concept-snippet",
		PrimaryStack:   &primary,
		Stacks:         []string{"neutral"},
		TargetConcepts: []string{"sequence"},
		Translations: []domain.LessonExampleI18n{
			{I18nID: 1, Title: "Порядок", Description: "RU **Markdown**"},
			{I18nID: 2, Title: "Order", Description: "EN **Markdown**"},
		},
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonExamplesValidatesTranslationsAndPersists(t *testing.T) {
	examples := &exampleRepositoryStub{}
	uc := ReplaceLessonExamples{
		Lessons:  exampleLessonRepositoryStub{lesson: domain.Lesson{ID: exampleTestLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}},
		Examples: examples,
		I18n:     exampleI18nRepositoryStub{languages: map[int]string{1: "ru", 2: "en"}},
	}

	if err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), exampleTestLessonID, []domain.LessonExample{validLessonExample()}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace examples: %v", err)
	}
	if len(examples.replaced) != 1 || examples.replaced[0].LessonID != exampleTestLessonID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected replacement: %#v", examples.replaced)
	}
	if examples.replaced[0].Translations[0].Description != "RU **Markdown**" {
		t.Fatalf("Markdown body changed: %#v", examples.replaced[0].Translations)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonExamplesAcceptsAdditionalTranslations(t *testing.T) {
	example := validLessonExample()
	example.Translations = append(example.Translations, domain.LessonExampleI18n{
		I18nID: 3, Title: "Reihenfolge", Description: "DE **Markdown**",
	})
	examples := &exampleRepositoryStub{}
	err := (ReplaceLessonExamples{
		Lessons:  exampleLessonRepositoryStub{lesson: domain.Lesson{ID: exampleTestLessonID}},
		Examples: examples,
		I18n:     exampleI18nRepositoryStub{languages: map[int]string{1: "ru", 2: "en", 3: "de"}},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), exampleTestLessonID, []domain.LessonExample{example})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace example with additional translation: %v", err)
	}
	if len(examples.replaced) != 1 || len(examples.replaced[0].Translations) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("additional translation was not persisted: %#v", examples.replaced)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonExamplesAcceptsExplicitEmptySet(t *testing.T) {
	examples := &exampleRepositoryStub{}
	err := (ReplaceLessonExamples{
		Lessons:  exampleLessonRepositoryStub{lesson: domain.Lesson{ID: exampleTestLessonID}},
		Examples: examples,
		I18n:     exampleI18nRepositoryStub{languages: map[int]string{}},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), exampleTestLessonID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replace empty examples: %v", err)
	}
	if examples.replaced == nil || len(examples.replaced) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected non-nil empty replacement, got %#v", examples.replaced)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLessonExamplesRejectsInvalidContracts(t *testing.T) {
	base := validLessonExample()
	duplicateOrder := base
	duplicateOrder.ID = "30000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
	duplicateOrder.SourceKey = "foundation.lesson.second-example"
	invalidMode := base
	invalidMode.Mode = "Concept Snippet"
	missingStack := base
	missingStack.Stacks = nil
	missingLanguage := base

	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		examples  []domain.LessonExample
		languages map[int]string
	}{
		{name: "duplicate order", examples: []domain.LessonExample{base, duplicateOrder}, languages: map[int]string{1: "ru", 2: "en"}},
		{name: "invalid mode", examples: []domain.LessonExample{invalidMode}, languages: map[int]string{1: "ru", 2: "en"}},
		{name: "missing stack", examples: []domain.LessonExample{missingStack}, languages: map[int]string{1: "ru", 2: "en"}},
		{name: "missing RU language", examples: []domain.LessonExample{missingLanguage}, languages: map[int]string{1: "en", 2: "de"}},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := (ReplaceLessonExamples{
				Lessons:  exampleLessonRepositoryStub{lesson: domain.Lesson{ID: exampleTestLessonID}},
				Examples: &exampleRepositoryStub{},
				I18n:     exampleI18nRepositoryStub{languages: tt.languages},
			}).Handle(context.Background(), exampleTestLessonID, tt.examples)
			if err == nil || (!errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict)) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation/conflict error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestListLessonExamplesFiltersPublicContent(t *testing.T) {
	examples := &exampleRepositoryStub{listed: []domain.LessonExample{validLessonExample()}}
	uc := ListLessonExamples{
		Lessons:  exampleLessonRepositoryStub{lesson: domain.Lesson{ID: exampleTestLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}},
		Examples: examples,
	}
	items, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), exampleTestLessonID, true)
	if err != nil || len(items) != 1 || !examples.activeOnly {
		t.Fatalf("public list did not apply active filter: items=%#v activeOnly=%v err=%v", items, examples.activeOnly, err)
	}

	uc.Lessons = exampleLessonRepositoryStub{lesson: domain.Lesson{ID: exampleTestLessonID, Status: domain.LessonStatusNoActive}}
	if _, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), exampleTestLessonID, true); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("inactive lesson should be hidden, got %v", err)
	}
}
